class.name: FmodEvent
class.brief_description: An instance of an FMOD Studio event that can be played and controlled.
class.description:
FmodEvent represents an instance of an FMOD Studio event. It provides control over playback, parameters, and 3D positioning. Event instances are created from [FmodEventDescription] objects through [FmodServer].
Event instances can be: - Started and stopped - Positioned in 3D space - Controlled with parameters - Monitored for playback state - Attached to nodes for automatic position updates
Events should be released when no longer needed to free resources.

method.name: event_key_off
method.description: Triggers the key off point of the event, allowing it to move past sustain points and enter the release phase.

method.name: get_channel_group
method.description: Returns the channel group the event instance plays through, whose DSP clock can schedule sounds in time with it. It is null until the instance starts playing.

method.name: get_parameter_by_id
method.description: Gets the value FMOD uses for a parameter, by its numerical ID. FMOD computes it on each [method FmodServer.update] from the value set from code and what FMOD Studio applies to the parameter: automatic parameters such as distance, automation, modulation and seek speed. A value set from code shows up after the next update. [method get_parameter_user_value_by_id] gives the value set from code.

method.name: get_parameter_by_name
method.description: Gets the value FMOD uses for a parameter, by its name. FMOD computes it on each [method FmodServer.update] from the value set from code and what FMOD Studio applies to the parameter: automatic parameters such as distance, automation, modulation and seek speed. A value set from code shows up after the next update. [method get_parameter_user_value_by_name] gives the value set from code.

method.name: get_parameter_user_value_by_id
method.description: Gets the value set from code for a parameter, by its numerical ID, or its default value when code never set one. Unlike the value FMOD uses, it ignores automatic parameters, automation, modulation and seek speed.

method.name: get_parameter_user_value_by_name
method.description: Gets the value set from code for a parameter, by its name, or its default value when code never set one. Unlike the value FMOD uses, it ignores automatic parameters, automation, modulation and seek speed.

method.name: get_playback_state
method.description: Returns the current playback state of the event. See FMOD_STUDIO_PLAYBACK_STATE enum for possible values.

method.name: get_programmer_callback_sound_key
method.description: Returns the sound key used for programmer sound callbacks.

method.name: get_reverb_level
method.description: Gets the reverb level for the specified reverb index.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the underlying FMOD event instance exists. It becomes invalid once released or once its bank is unloaded.

method.name: is_virtual
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the event is virtual (not actually playing due to voice limits).

method.name: release
method.description: Releases the event instance, allowing it to be cleaned up when it stops playing. This should be called for all event instances when they are no longer needed.

method.name: set_callback
method.description: Sets a callback function to receive event notifications. The mask determines which types of callbacks to receive.

method.name: set_node_attributes
method.description: Sets the spatial attributes of the event based on a node's transform. For 3D nodes, uses the global transform; for 2D nodes, uses the global transform.

method.name: set_parameter_by_id
method.description: Sets the value of a parameter by its numerical ID.

method.name: set_parameter_by_id_with_label
method.description: Sets a parameter by its ID using a labeled value (for enum parameters). If ignoreseekspeed is true, the parameter will be set instantly.

method.name: set_parameter_by_name
method.description: Sets the value of a parameter by its name.

method.name: set_parameter_by_name_with_label
method.description: Sets a parameter by its name using a labeled value (for enum parameters). If ignoreseekspeed is true, the parameter will be set instantly.

method.name: set_programmer_callback
method.description: Sets the sound key for programmer sound callbacks. This is used with programmer instruments in FMOD Studio.

method.name: set_reverb_level
method.description: Sets the reverb level for the specified reverb index.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts playback of the event. The event must have been created from an [FmodEventDescription] first.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the event with the specified stop mode. Use FMOD_STUDIO_STOP_ALLOWFADEOUT for smooth stopping or FMOD_STUDIO_STOP_IMMEDIATE for instant stopping.

The callback is called on each beat of a tempo marker on the event's timeline. The callback's data holds the bar, beat, position, tempo and time signature.

The callback is called when an instrument of the event stops playing a sound.
The callback is called when the event instance becomes virtual: FMOD stops mixing it to save voices, while keeping its timeline running.
The callback is called when the event instance stops being virtual and is mixed again.
The callback is called when a start event command instrument starts another event instance.
The callback is called on each beat of a tempo marker in a nested event's timeline.
